[{"insert":"Seated Dumbbell Press 

Back to the seated dumbbell press with reps dropping to 6 across the working sets. The dumbbell version lets each arm work independently along slightly different paths than the barbell, which reduces the risk of shoulder impingement at heavier loads. The set finishes with a max unbroken drop set at Set 1 weight. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can.
"}]
